# Intention Tenure

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:IntentionTenure`](gmeow-IntentionTenure.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/IntentionTenure>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/teleology`](../../slices/teleology.md)

The reified, time-scoped fact that an agent held an intentional mode over an interval — a goal adopted in January and abandoned in June is an opened-then-closed tenure, never a deletion ([Principle 10](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-10)). The [`StandpointTenure`](gmeow-StandpointTenure.md) idiom applied to teleology: use only when adoption / revision is itself worth modelling; the common case is a bare [`gmeow:hasGoal`](../properties/gmeow-hasGoal.md) with [`validFrom`](../properties/gmeow-validFrom.md) / [`validUntil`](../properties/gmeow-validUntil.md) on the statement. Carries its interval via [`gmeow:duringInterval`](../properties/gmeow-duringInterval.md) (temporal module); a withdrawn tenure is kept with [`gmeow:displayable`](../properties/gmeow-displayable.md) false.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:TimeScopedRelation`](gmeow-TimeScopedRelation.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:IntentionTenure`](gmeow-IntentionTenure.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:TimeScopedRelation`](gmeow-TimeScopedRelation.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
